# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.8.2

Version 1.8.2 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.8.1

**Held upright: boards no longer show twice, one stacked on the other.** v1.8.1 draws the trees and items of the far
acres the game itself does not draw. To tell which acres the game draws it read the block numbers of the game's draw
tables, which the game sets only when an acre comes into view, not when its item actor is made (so, at times, after a
scene was loaded they did not name the acres drawn). Those acres' items were then drawn a second time, placed on the
height of the ground's collision, which for the notice board, the map board and the music board is their top: a second
board stood on the first. Now the acres the game draws are read from its item table, and the far items stand on the
units' ground heights as the game places them (so even a second drawing would fall exactly on the first).

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.8.1's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.2-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.2-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.2-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.2-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Held upright (720x1560), by script: the notice board right after loading and after a warp, the map board after leaving
  the house, the far acres at the north edges of acres (the same screenshots as v1.8.1's, pixel for pixel), a check that
  logged every acre where the old and the new way of telling the game's acres disagree, over loading, warps across the
  town and leaving a house (none disagreed there: the doubling comes from a case the scripts do not reach, which the new
  way covers whatever the case).
- Landscape: unchanged (the far drawing is only upright). Of the fifteen touch checks run on v1.8.1's release and on
  this version, fourteen log the same and give the same screenshots; the fifteenth holds a finger for a time measured
  in milliseconds and ends a unit or two apart, as two runs of v1.8.1 itself do.
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.7.0 and
  on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.8.2, versionCode 10802); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.8.1's.

## Known limitations

- Held upright, the buildings and villagers of acres two or more away are not shown.
- The upright layout was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.8.1 remain (see the [v1.8.1 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.8.1)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
